reference: Every page of TshepoVet's web app, read from apps/web/app/**/page.tsx: its shell, who can open it, and its regions top to bottom. Open a page to see its layout; edit it, or write a change request, and Claude applies it at the next sync. `npm run design:check` fails when a page exists in the code but not here, or the reverse.

shell.summary: Signed-in pages (the buyer portal and the staff console) sit in a collapsible left sidebar shell: a skip link, the sandbox band, a 17rem sidebar on large screens that collapses to a 6rem rail, and the main column up to 90rem wide. Public pages have a top bar and a footer; account pages a centred card.
header: Phones/tablets only: top bar with brand (seal, 'TshepoVet', organisation legal name) and a 'Menu' button
shell.mobile: Below 1024px the sidebar is hidden; a top bar shows the brand and a 'Menu' button that opens a dialog titled 'Menu' with the same nav list and, under a rule, the account button/menu. Content is single-column; tables scroll sideways.
banners: The sandbox band (Specimen) on every page

shells.name: Public site
regions: Skip link 'Skip to main content' (visible on focus)

Sandbox band (only when the API says sandbox): 'Specimen. This is the TshepoVet sandbox: checks use test data, top-ups are pretend money, and nothing here is a real verification.' with a guilloche pattern on the right
Top bar: brand link to / (seal + 'TshepoVet') on the left; 'Site' nav on the right: Pricing, API documentation (/docs/), Sign in, 'Create an account' (violet button)
Main: full width; each page sets its own centred column
Footer: links Words we use, Privacy notice, Terms of use, Check a supplier passport, Design system; line 'TshepoVet checks South African suppliers. Information is processed in line with POPIA.'
Print: top bar and footer hidden, sandbox band kept
shells.phone: No hamburger: the brand and the four top-bar links wrap onto extra lines; footer links wrap; content columns stack.

shells.name: Buyer portal
regions: Skip link
Sandbox band (sandbox only), above everything
Phones/tablets only: top bar with brand (seal, 'TshepoVet', organisation legal name) and a 'Menu' button

Desktop (lg and up): sticky left sidebar, collapsible (Q1). Expanded, 17rem: brand at top (seal, 'TshepoVet', organisation legal name, links to /app); 'Portal' nav list with icons; at the bottom, under a rule, 'Collapse menu' and the account button (initials avatar, full name, email, chevron) opening a menu: organisation name label, 'Your account', separator, 'Sign out'. Collapsed, a 6rem rail: the seal; each section's icon with its name under it; 'Expand menu'; 'Account'. The choice is remembered per browser
Main: content column up to 90rem wide, no page footer

Nav items are filtered by the user's permissions: Overview, Suppliers, Checks, Monitoring need suppliers:read; Wallet wallet:read; Developers developers:manage; Team team:read; Compliance compliance:read; Modules and Settings always shown
While loading the session: full-screen spinner 'Opening TshepoVet'; signed-out visitors go to /sign-in?next=...
If the session stage is mfa_setup: the nav is hidden and every page except /app/mfa-setup redirects there (spinner 'Opening two-step verification setup')
shells.phone: Below 1024px the sidebar is hidden; a top bar shows the brand and a 'Menu' button that opens a dialog titled 'Menu' with the same nav list and, under a rule, the account button/menu. Content is single-column; tables scroll sideways.
